summary.headline: Mars–Saturn Conjunction Omens
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of Mars and Saturn in the earthy triplicity, Taurus, and Virgo, including sedition, war, disease, famine, crop and water corruption, earthquakes, locusts, and disasters affecting rulers and regions such as Rum, Hamadān, Māhān, Transoxiana, Khūzistān, the lands of the Copts, and Nubia.
